categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unauthenticated slowloris DoS vector where trickle-read clients can permanently occupy all HTTP connection slots and block RPC access. As demonstrated in the PR description, a client sending a byte every ten seconds continually resets the read timeout without ever completing a request or hitting authentication, exhausting -rpcmaxconnections and causing legitimate callers like bitcoin-cli to hang indefinitely.
